```{r}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(
here,
rio,
ggridges,
table1,
grid
)
options(scipen = 999)

source(here("Code", "Helper_functions.R"))
source(here("Code", "SPF.BinCont.Cov_v2.R"))
```

```{r}
# Load data

h1n1_ICA_main <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_main_26-07-06-19-09.csv"))
h1n1_ICA_mono <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_mono_26-07-06-22-28.csv"))
h1n1_ICA_indep <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_indep_26-07-07-04-15.csv"))
h1n1_ICA_HVCA <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_HVCA_26-07-07-08-19.csv"))

h1n1_ICA_Cond_ind <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_Cond_ind_26-07-07-12-09.csv"))
h1n1_ICA_full_id_mono <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_full_id_mono_26-07-06-15-41.csv"))
h1n1_ICA_full_id_indep <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_full_id_indep_26-07-06-15-42.csv"))

h1n1_ICA_no_covar_noboot_df  <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_no_covar_noboot_26_07_13.csv"))
h1n1_ICA_main_noboot_df <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_main_noboot_26_07_13.csv"))

h1n1_ICA_all <- bind_rows(
  main      = h1n1_ICA_main,
  mono      = h1n1_ICA_mono,
  indep     = h1n1_ICA_indep,
  HVCA      = h1n1_ICA_HVCA,
  cond_ind  = h1n1_ICA_Cond_ind,
  full_id_mono  = h1n1_ICA_full_id_mono,
  full_id_indep = h1n1_ICA_full_id_indep,
  .id = "source"
)

h1n1_ICA_all$source <- factor(h1n1_ICA_all$source, 
                              levels = c("full_id_indep","full_id_mono", "cond_ind", "HVCA", "indep", "mono", "main"),
                              labels = c("Independence, HVCA and CI", "Monotonicity, HVCA and CI", "Conditional independence (CI)",
                                         "Homogenous variance-covariance (HVCA)",
                                         "Independence", "Monotonicity", "None (primary analysis)"))
```

```{r}
h1n1_ICA_hi_q1 <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_main_hi_q1_26-07-27-04-15.csv"))
h1n1_ICA_hi_q3 <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_main_hi_q3_26-07-27-09-07.csv"))

h1n1_ICA_posthoc <- import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_posthoc_26-09-15-05-24.csv"))
```

```{r}
h1n1_ICA_main_200b <-  import(here("Results", "h1n1_ICA_main_200boot_26-11-25-19-14.csv"))
```


# 1. H1N1 - Main analysis with no assumption

```{r}
# Add AIC
h1n1_ICA_main <- h1n1_ICA_main %>%
  mutate(
    AIC_S0 = dev_S0 + 2*12,
    AIC_S1 = dev_S1 + 2*12,
  ) %>%
  mutate(AIC_tot = AIC_S0 + AIC_S1)
```

```{r}
h1n1_ICA_main_summary <- summarise_ICA(dat= h1n1_ICA_main)
```

```{r}
table1(~ pi_00 + pi_01 + pi_10+ pi_11+ G_rho_01_00+ G_rho_01_01+ G_rho_01_10+ G_rho_01_11+
       mu_0_00+ mu_0_01+ mu_0_10+ mu_0_11+ gamma_0+ sigma2_00_00 +
         mu_1_00+ mu_1_01+ mu_1_10+ mu_1_11+ gamma_1 + sigma2_11_00, data = h1n1_ICA_main)
```

# 8. Display all above distributions in a ridgeline plot

```{r}

ggplot(h1n1_ICA_all, aes(x = R2_H, y = source, fill = source)) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  scale_fill_discrete(palette = c("#C7C7C7","#AA6F9E", "#4D4D4D", "#009E73", "#e69b00", "#2f357c", "#bf3729")) +
  theme_ridges() + 
  labs(x = expression(R[H]^2 ~ "                                "))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
         plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA)
        )

ggsave(
        filename = here("Plot", "h1n1_ICA_all.png" ),
        dpi = 300,
        units = "cm"
      )
```

Table + figure combined

```{r}

# Values to display beside the ridgeline plot
ica_summary <- tibble(
  source = c(
    "None (primary analysis)",
    "Monotonicity",
    "Independence",
    "Homogenous variance-covariance (HVCA)",
    "Conditional independence (CI)",
    "Monotonicity, HVCA and CI",
    "Independence, HVCA and CI"
  ),
  mean_ica = c(
    0.573,
    0.569,
    0.632,
    0.568,
    0.557,
    0.549,
    0.613
  ),
  sdi_80 = c(
    "[0.423, 0.728]",
    "[0.421, 0.731]",
    "[0.476, 0.791]",
    "[0.391, 0.767]",
    "[0.444, 0.671]",
    "[0.463, 0.655]",
    "[0.515, 0.703]"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source, levels = levels(h1n1_ICA_all$source))
  )


# For centering the X axis label
x_min <- -0.03
x_max <- 1.52
density_center <- 0.50

title_position <- (density_center - x_min) / (x_max - x_min)

# Main plot
ggplot(
  h1n1_ICA_all,
  aes(x = R2_H, y = source, fill = source)
) +
  geom_density_ridges() +

  # Optional separator between the plot and numerical columns
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1.05,
    colour = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # Mean iCA column
  geom_text(
    data = ica_summary,
    aes(
      x = 1.16,
      y = source,
      label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_ica)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.8,
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +

  # 80% SDI column
  geom_text(
    data = ica_summary,
    aes(
      x = 1.39,
      y = source,
      label = sdi_80
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.8,
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +

  # Column headings
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.16,
    y = Inf,
    label = "Mean ICA",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    vjust = -1
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.39,
    y = Inf,
    label = "80% SDI",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    vjust = -1
  ) +

  scale_fill_discrete(
    palette = c(
      "#C7C7C7",
      "#AA6F9E",
      "#4D4D4D",
      "#009E73",
      "#e69b00",
      "#2f357c",
      "#bf3729"
    )
  ) +

  # Extend plotting area to make room for the columns
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    limits = c(-0.03, 1.52),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  # clip = "off" allows headings above the plotting panel
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  theme_ridges() +

  labs(
    x = expression(R[H]^2),
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_text(hjust = title_position, margin = margin(t = 12)), 
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      colour = NA
    ),

    # Add room above the plot for the column headings
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 35,
      r = 15,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  )

ggsave(
        filename = here("Plot", "h1n1_ICA_all2.png" ),
        dpi = 300,
        units = "cm",
        width = 25,
        height = 10
      )
```

# 12. SPF

```{r}
spf_h1n1 <- SPF.BinCont.Cov(
  h1n1_ICA_main, 
  a = 0,
  b = log(32)
)


```

```{r}
spf_cat <- c("r_min1_min1", "r_0_min1", "r_1_min1", "r_min1_0", "r_0_0", "r_1_0", "r_min1_1", "r_0_1", "r_1_1")
lapply(spf_h1n1[spf_cat], hist)
```

```{r}
spf_cat <- c(
  "r_min1_min1", "r_0_min1", "r_1_min1",
  "r_min1_0",    "r_0_0",    "r_1_0",
  "r_min1_1",    "r_0_1",    "r_1_1"
)

# Extract data
dat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(spf_cat, function(nm) {

  parts <- strsplit(sub("^r_", "", nm), "_")[[1]]

  data.frame(
    value = spf_h1n1[[nm]],
    dT = parts[1],
    dS = parts[2]
  )
}))

dat$dT <- factor(dat$dT, levels = c("min1", "0", "1"),
                 labels = c("-1", "0", "1"))
dat$dS <- factor(dat$dS, levels = c("min1", "0", "1"),
                 labels = c("(-Inf, log(1)]", "(log(1), log(32)]", "(log(32), +Inf)"))


ggplot(dat, aes(x = dS, y = value, fill = dT)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#e69b00", "#2f357c", "#bf3729"),
    name = expression(Delta*T)
  ) +
  labs(x = expression(Delta*S), y = "Probability") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave(here("Plot", "SPF_H1N1.png"))
```
